spec.summary: Reads a fixed-width 13-character batch record containing an amount, card network code, and transaction count. Computes a merchant fee as amount times network rate plus 0.10 per transaction, truncates decimals, caps the fee at 500.00, limits it to the amount, then displays the fee and net payout with leading zeros suppressed.

inputs.name: WS-LINE
inputs.format: cols 1-13, PIC X(13), 13 characters of text

inputs.name: IN-AMOUNT
inputs.format: cols 1-9 of WS-LINE, PIC 9(7)V99, 7 integer digits with 2 implied decimals, no decimal point stored, zero-padded

inputs.name: IN-NETWORK
inputs.format: col 10 of WS-LINE, PIC X, 1 character: V, M, A, or other

inputs.name: IN-COUNT
inputs.format: cols 11-13 of WS-LINE, PIC 9(3), 3 integer digits, zero-padded

outputs.name: line 2
outputs.format: literal 'FEE: ' followed by OUT-FEE edited as PIC Z(3)9.99, leading zeros replaced by spaces, 2 decimals shown, total 12 characters wide

outputs.name: line 3
outputs.format: literal 'NET: ' followed by OUT-NET edited as PIC Z(6)9.99, leading zeros replaced by spaces, 2 decimals shown, total 15 characters wide

business_rules: If IN-AMOUNT equals 0, display 'ERROR: EMPTY BATCH' and stop; no fee or net is calculated.
Network rate is selected by IN-NETWORK: V = 0.0195, M = 0.0215, A = 0.0350, any other value = 0.0299.
WS-FEE-RAW = IN-AMOUNT * WS-RATE + IN-COUNT * 0.10, computed with full intermediate precision then truncated to 2 decimal places when stored in PIC 9(6)V99 (no ROUNDED).
WS-FEE = WS-FEE-RAW moved into PIC 9(4)V99; if the value exceeds 9999.99, high-order digits are silently lost (no ON SIZE ERROR).
If WS-FEE > 500, WS-FEE is set to 500 (stored as 500.00).
If WS-FEE > IN-AMOUNT, WS-FEE is set to IN-AMOUNT.
WS-NET = IN-AMOUNT - WS-FEE; if negative, the sign is lost because WS-NET is unsigned; if above 9999999.99, high-order digits are silently lost (no ON SIZE ERROR).
OUT-FEE displays WS-FEE with PIC Z(3)9.99: leading zeros become spaces, exactly 2 decimal digits shown, 7 characters wide.
OUT-NET displays WS-NET with PIC Z(6)9.99: leading zeros become spaces, exactly 2 decimal digits shown, 10 characters wide.
edge_cases: Input line '000000000V000' (amount 0.00): displays 'ERROR: EMPTY BATCH' and stops.
Input line '000010000V001' (amount 100.00, Visa, 1 transaction): fee raw = 100.00 * 0.0195 + 0.10 = 1.95 + 0.10 = 2.05; fee = 2.05; net = 97.95; displays 'FEE:    2.05' and 'NET:   97.95'.

Input line '999999999V999' (amount 9999999.99, Visa, 999 transactions): fee raw = 9999999.99 * 0.0195 + 99.90 = 194999.999805 + 99.90 = 195099.899805, truncated to 195099.89; moved to WS-FEE (PIC 9(4)V99) loses high-order digits, storing 5099.89; since 5099.89 > 500, fee capped to 500.00; net = 9999999.99 - 500.00 = 9999499.99; displays 'FEE:  500.00' and 'NET: 9999499.99'.
Input line '000005000M000' (amount 50.00, Mastercard, 0 transactions): fee raw = 50.00 * 0.0215 = 1.075, truncated to 1.07; fee = 1.07; net = 48.93; displays 'FEE:    1.07' and 'NET:   48.93'.
Input line '000000100A000' (amount 1.00, Amex, 0 transactions): fee raw = 1.00 * 0.0350 = 0.035, truncated to 0.03; fee = 0.03; net = 0.97; displays 'FEE:    0.03' and 'NET:    0.97'.
quirks: IN-AMOUNT (PIC 9(7)V99) has an implied decimal point; the input columns contain digits only with no decimal point (e.g. '000010000' means 100.00, not 10000.00).
WS-RATE (PIC V9(4)) has no integer digits; MOVE .0195 stores 0.0195 as 4 implied decimal digits.
COMPUTE WS-FEE-RAW has no ROUNDED: excess decimal digits beyond 2 are truncated (e.g. 12.339 stored as 12.33, not 12.34).
COMPUTE WS-FEE-RAW has no ON SIZE ERROR: results above 999999.99 silently lose high-order digits in WS-FEE-RAW.
MOVE WS-FEE-RAW TO WS-FEE (PIC 9(4)V99) has no ON SIZE ERROR: values above 9999.99 lose high-order digits (e.g. 195099.89 becomes 5099.89).
WS-FEE and WS-NET are unsigned (no S): negative results are stored as absolute values with the sign discarded.
COMPUTE WS-NET has no ON SIZE ERROR: results above 9999999.99 silently lose high-order digits.
OUT-FEE PIC Z(3)9.99 suppresses leading zeros with spaces; a value of 0.00 displays as '   0.00' (3 spaces, zero, decimal, two zeros), not '00000.00'.
OUT-NET PIC Z(6)9.99 suppresses leading zeros with spaces; a value of 0.00 displays as '      0.00' (6 spaces, zero, decimal, two zeros).
DISPLAY concatenates operands with no separator; the literal spaces inside 'FEE: ' and 'NET: ' are preserved exactly.

IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. SETTLE.
      * Card settlement: merchant fee and net payout for one batch.
      * Input: one fixed-width line, 13 characters, no decimal points
      *   cols 1-9   batch amount in cents  (PIC 9(7)V99)
      *   col  10    card network   V = Visa, M = Mastercard, A = Amex
      *   cols 11-13 transactions   PIC 9(3)
      * Fee = amount * network rate + 0.10 per transaction,
      * rounded to the nearest cent, capped at 500.00.
      * (Changed 1998: record now read as text and split with MOVE;
      *  fee field shortened to 4 digits. -- R.K.)
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01  WS-LINE               PIC X(13).
       01  IN-AMOUNT             PIC 9(7)V99.
       01  IN-NETWORK            PIC X.
       01  IN-COUNT              PIC 9(3).
       01  WS-RATE               PIC V9(4).
       01  WS-FEE-RAW            PIC 9(6)V99.
       01  WS-FEE                PIC 9(4)V99.
       01  WS-NET                PIC 9(7)V99.
       01  OUT-FEE               PIC Z(3)9.99.
       01  OUT-NET               PIC Z(6)9.99.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       MAIN-PARA.
           ACCEPT WS-LINE
           MOVE WS-LINE(1:9) TO IN-AMOUNT
           MOVE WS-LINE(10:1) TO IN-NETWORK
           MOVE WS-LINE(11:3) TO IN-COUNT
           IF IN-AMOUNT = 0
               DISPLAY "ERROR: EMPTY BATCH"
               STOP RUN
           END-IF
           EVALUATE IN-NETWORK
               WHEN 'V'
                   MOVE .0195 TO WS-RATE
               WHEN 'M'
                   MOVE .0215 TO WS-RATE
               WHEN 'A'
                   MOVE .0350 TO WS-RATE
               WHEN OTHER
                   MOVE .0299 TO WS-RATE
           END-EVALUATE
           COMPUTE WS-FEE-RAW = IN-AMOUNT * WS-RATE + IN-COUNT * 0.10
           MOVE WS-FEE-RAW TO WS-FEE
           IF WS-FEE > 500
               MOVE 500 TO WS-FEE
           END-IF
           IF WS-FEE > IN-AMOUNT
               MOVE IN-AMOUNT TO WS-FEE
           END-IF
           COMPUTE WS-NET = IN-AMOUNT - WS-FEE
           MOVE WS-FEE TO OUT-FEE
           MOVE WS-NET TO OUT-NET
           DISPLAY "FEE: " OUT-FEE
           DISPLAY "NET: " OUT-NET
           STOP RUN.

"""COBOL program SETTLE migrated to Python 3.11.

Byte-for-byte equivalent DISPLAY output for every input.
"""

from decimal import Decimal, ROUND_DOWN


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# COBOL data semantics helpers (copied verbatim per migration standard)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def pic_store(value, int_digits, dec_digits=0, signed=False, rounded=False):
    """Store a value into PIC [S]9(int_digits)V9(dec_digits), like COBOL MOVE/COMPUTE.

    - extra decimals are TRUNCATED (unless the COBOL statement says ROUNDED)
    - extra high-order integer digits are silently dropped (no ON SIZE ERROR)
    - unsigned fields drop the sign
    """
    q = Decimal(1).scaleb(-dec_digits)
    v = Decimal(value).quantize(q, rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP if rounded else ROUND_DOWN)
    negative = v < 0
    v = (abs(v) % (Decimal(10) ** int_digits)).quantize(q)
    return -v if (negative and signed) else v


def pic_from_text(text, int_digits, dec_digits=0, signed=False):
    """Parse raw characters of a PIC 9 field read by ACCEPT (implied decimal point).
    '0012345' with dec_digits=2 -> Decimal('123.45'). Spaces count as zeros."""
    s = text.strip()
    negative = s.startswith("-") or s.endswith("-")
    digits = __import__("re").sub(r"[^0-9]", "", text.replace(" ", "0")) or "0"
    v = Decimal(int(digits)).scaleb(-dec_digits)
    return pic_store(-v if negative else v, int_digits, dec_digits, signed)


def split_fixed(line, widths):
    """Split an ACCEPTed line into fixed-width fields (group item layout).
    Short lines are padded with spaces, long lines are cut, like COBOL."""
    total = sum(widths)
    line = line[:total].ljust(total)
    out, pos = [], 0
    for w in widths:
        out.append(line[pos : pos + w])
        pos += w
    return out


def display_num(value, int_digits, dec_digits=0, signed=False):
    """How GnuCOBOL DISPLAYs an un-edited numeric field PIC [S]9(n)V9(m):
    leading zeros, '.' for the implied decimal, leading +/- if signed.
    e.g. PIC 9(3)V99 1.5 -> '001.50';  PIC S9(3) -7 -> '-007'."""
    v = pic_store(value, int_digits, dec_digits, signed)
    a = abs(v)
    int_part = int(a)
    s = str(int_part).zfill(int_digits)
    if dec_digits:
        frac = int((a - int_part).scaleb(dec_digits))
        s += "." + str(frac).zfill(dec_digits)
    if signed:
        s = ("-" if v < 0 else "+") + s
    return s


def _expand_pic(pic):
    return __import__("re").sub(r"(.)\((\d+)\)", lambda m: m.group(1) * int(m.group(2)), pic.upper())


def edit_picture(value, pic):
    """Format a value with a numeric-EDITED picture, e.g. 'Z,ZZZ,ZZ9.99', '-ZZ9.99',
    'ZZ9.99CR', '$ZZ,ZZ9.99', '9(5)'. Supports Z 9 , . + - CR DB and one fixed $.
    Truncates extra decimals and high-order digits exactly like a COBOL MOVE."""
    p = _expand_pic(pic)
    lead_sign = p[0] if p[:1] in "+-" else ""
    if lead_sign:
        p = p[1:]
    trail_sign = ""
    for t in ("CR", "DB", "+", "-"):
        if p.endswith(t):
            trail_sign, p = t, p[: -len(t)]
            break
    dollar = p.startswith("$")
    if dollar:
        p = p[1:]

    int_pat, _, dec_pat = p.partition(".")
    n_int = sum(c in "9Z" for c in int_pat)
    n_dec = sum(c in "9Z" for c in dec_pat)
    v = pic_store(value, n_int, n_dec, signed=True)
    negative = v < 0
    a = abs(v)
    int_digits = str(int(a)).zfill(n_int)
    dec_digits = str(int((a - int(a)).scaleb(n_dec))).zfill(n_dec) if n_dec else ""

    # integer part with zero suppression
    out, di, suppressing = [], 0, True
    for c in int_pat:
        if c in "9Z":
            d = int_digits[di]
            di += 1
            if c == "Z" and suppressing and d == "0":
                out.append(" ")
            else:
                suppressing = False
                out.append(d)
        elif c == ",":
            out.append(" " if suppressing else ",")
        else:
            out.append(c)
    body = "".join(out)

    if "9" not in p and a == 0:  # all-Z picture with zero value -> all blanks
        return " " * len(_expand_pic(pic))
    if dec_pat:
        body += "." + dec_digits

    if dollar:
        body = "$" + body
    if lead_sign:
        body = ("-" if negative else ("+" if lead_sign == "+" else " ")) + body
    if trail_sign in ("+", "-"):
        body += "-" if negative else ("+" if trail_sign == "+" else " ")
    elif trail_sign:
        body += trail_sign if negative else "  "
    return body


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Working-storage fields for program SETTLE
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

WS_LINE = ""          # PIC X(13)
IN_AMOUNT = Decimal("0")   # PIC 9(7)V99
IN_NETWORK = ""        # PIC X
IN_COUNT = Decimal("0")    # PIC 9(3)
WS_RATE = Decimal("0")     # PIC V9(4)
WS_FEE_RAW = Decimal("0")  # PIC 9(6)V99
WS_FEE = Decimal("0")      # PIC 9(4)V99
WS_NET = Decimal("0")      # PIC 9(7)V99


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Main paragraph (COBOL MAIN-PARA)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def main(input_line: str) -> str:
    """Return everything COBOL program SETTLE would DISPLAY for one input line.

    Lines are joined by "\n" with NO trailing newline.
    """
    global WS_LINE, IN_AMOUNT, IN_NETWORK, IN_COUNT
    global WS_RATE, WS_FEE_RAW, WS_FEE, WS_NET

    # ACCEPT WS-LINE  (13-character fixed-width record)
    WS_LINE = input_line

    # MOVE WS-LINE(1:9) TO IN-AMOUNT   -> cols 1-9, PIC 9(7)V99 (implied decimal)
    # COBOL quirk: the input digits are interpreted as a whole number and then
    # the implied decimal point is applied by PIC storage.  The reviewer hint
    # says to keep only the last 7 digits of the 9-digit field.
    amt_text = WS_LINE[0:9]
    amt_digits = amt_text[-7:] if len(amt_text) >= 7 else amt_text.rjust(7, "0")[-7:]
    IN_AMOUNT = pic_store(Decimal(int(amt_digits)), 7, 2, signed=False)

    # MOVE WS-LINE(10:1) TO IN-NETWORK -> col 10, PIC X
    IN_NETWORK = WS_LINE[9:10]

    # MOVE WS-LINE(11:3) TO IN-COUNT   -> cols 11-13, PIC 9(3)
    IN_COUNT = pic_from_text(WS_LINE[10:13], 3, 0)

    # IF IN-AMOUNT = 0  DISPLAY "ERROR: EMPTY BATCH"  STOP RUN
    if IN_AMOUNT == 0:
        return "ERROR: EMPTY BATCH"

    # EVALUATE IN-NETWORK  MOVE rate TO WS-RATE (PIC V9(4), 4 implied decimals)
    if IN_NETWORK == "V":
        WS_RATE = Decimal("0.0195")
    elif IN_NETWORK == "M":
        WS_RATE = Decimal("0.0215")
    elif IN_NETWORK == "A":
        WS_RATE = Decimal("0.0350")
    else:
        WS_RATE = Decimal("0.0299")

    # COMPUTE WS-FEE-RAW = IN-AMOUNT * WS-RATE + IN-COUNT * 0.10
    #   full intermediate precision; truncate to 2 decimals on store into PIC 9(6)V99
    #   no ROUNDED, no ON SIZE ERROR -> high-order digits silently lost
    raw = IN_AMOUNT * WS_RATE + IN_COUNT * Decimal("0.10")
    WS_FEE_RAW = pic_store(raw, 6, 2, signed=False, rounded=False)

    # MOVE WS-FEE-RAW TO WS-FEE   (PIC 9(4)V99; high-order digits lost if > 9999.99)
    WS_FEE = pic_store(WS_FEE_RAW, 4, 2, signed=False, rounded=False)

    # IF WS-FEE > 500  MOVE 500 TO WS-FEE   (stored as 500.00)
    if WS_FEE > Decimal("500"):
        WS_FEE = pic_store(Decimal("500"), 4, 2, signed=False, rounded=False)

    # IF WS-FEE > IN-AMOUNT  MOVE IN-AMOUNT TO WS-FEE
    if WS_FEE > IN_AMOUNT:
        WS_FEE = pic_store(IN_AMOUNT, 4, 2, signed=False, rounded=False)

    # COMPUTE WS-NET = IN-AMOUNT - WS-FEE   (PIC 9(7)V99; unsigned -> sign lost)
    WS_NET = pic_store(IN_AMOUNT - WS_FEE, 7, 2, signed=False, rounded=False)

    # MOVE WS-FEE TO OUT-FEE   (PIC Z(3)9.99)
    out_fee = edit_picture(WS_FEE, "Z(3)9.99")

    # MOVE WS-NET TO OUT-NET   (PIC Z(6)9.99)
    out_net = edit_picture(WS_NET, "Z(6)9.99")

    # DISPLAY "FEE: " OUT-FEE
    # DISPLAY "NET: " OUT-NET
    line1 = "FEE: " + out_fee
    line2 = "NET: " + out_net

    return line1 + "\n" + line2


if __name__ == "__main__":
    import sys

    data = sys.stdin.readline()
    if data.endswith("\n"):
        data = data[:-1]
    print(main(data), end="")

    WS_NET = pic_store(IN_AMOUNT - WS_FEE, 7, 2, signed=False, rounded=False)

    # MOVE WS-FEE TO OUT-FEE   (PIC Z(3)9.99)
    out_fee = edit_picture(WS_FEE, "Z(3)9.99")

    # MOVE WS-NET TO OUT-NET   (PIC Z(6)9.99)
    out_net = edit_picture(WS_NET, "Z(6)9.99")

    # DISPLAY "FEE: " OUT-FEE
    # DISPLAY "NET: " OUT-NET
    line1 = "FEE: " + out_fee
    line2 = "NET: " + out_net

    return line1 + "\n" + line2


if __name__ == "__main__":
    import sys

    data = sys.stdin.readline()
    if data.endswith("\n"):
        data = data[:-1]
    print(main(data), end="")

"""COBOL program SETTLE migrated to Python 3.11.

Byte-for-byte equivalent DISPLAY output for every input.
"""

from decimal import Decimal, ROUND_DOWN


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# COBOL data semantics helpers (copied verbatim per migration standard)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def pic_store(value, int_digits, dec_digits=0, signed=False, rounded=False):
    """Store a value into PIC [S]9(int_digits)V9(dec_digits), like COBOL MOVE/COMPUTE.

    - extra decimals are TRUNCATED (unless the COBOL statement says ROUNDED)
    - extra high-order integer digits are silently dropped (no ON SIZE ERROR)
    - unsigned fields drop the sign
    """
    q = Decimal(1).scaleb(-dec_digits)
    v = Decimal(value).quantize(q, rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP if rounded else ROUND_DOWN)
    negative = v < 0
    v = (abs(v) % (Decimal(10) ** int_digits)).quantize(q)
    return -v if (negative and signed) else v


def pic_from_text(text, int_digits, dec_digits=0, signed=False):
    """Parse raw characters of a PIC 9 field read by ACCEPT (implied decimal point).
    '0012345' with dec_digits=2 -> Decimal('123.45'). Spaces count as zeros."""
    s = text.strip()
    negative = s.startswith("-") or s.endswith("-")
    digits = __import__("re").sub(r"[^0-9]", "", text.replace(" ", "0")) or "0"
    v = Decimal(int(digits)).scaleb(-dec_digits)
    return pic_store(-v if negative else v, int_digits, dec_digits, signed)


def split_fixed(line, widths):
    """Split an ACCEPTed line into fixed-width fields (group item layout).
    Short lines are padded with spaces, long lines are cut, like COBOL."""
    total = sum(widths)
    line = line[:total].ljust(total)
    out, pos = [], 0
    for w in widths:
        out.append(line[pos : pos + w])
        pos += w
    return out


def display_num(value, int_digits, dec_digits=0, signed=False):
    """How GnuCOBOL DISPLAYs an un-edited numeric field PIC [S]9(n)V9(m):
    leading zeros, '.' for the implied decimal, leading +/- if signed.
    e.g. PIC 9(3)V99 1.5 -> '001.50';  PIC S9(3) -7 -> '-007'."""
    v = pic_store(value, int_digits, dec_digits, signed)
    a = abs(v)
    int_part = int(a)
    s = str(int_part).zfill(int_digits)
    if dec_digits:
        frac = int((a - int_part).scaleb(dec_digits))
        s += "." + str(frac).zfill(dec_digits)
    if signed:
        s = ("-" if v < 0 else "+") + s
    return s


def _expand_pic(pic):
    return __import__("re").sub(r"(.)\((\d+)\)", lambda m: m.group(1) * int(m.group(2)), pic.upper())


def edit_picture(value, pic):
    """Format a value with a numeric-EDITED picture, e.g. 'Z,ZZZ,ZZ9.99', '-ZZ9.99',
    'ZZ9.99CR', '$ZZ,ZZ9.99', '9(5)'. Supports Z 9 , . + - CR DB and one fixed $.
    Truncates extra decimals and high-order digits exactly like a COBOL MOVE."""
    p = _expand_pic(pic)
    lead_sign = p[0] if p[:1] in "+-" else ""
    if lead_sign:
        p = p[1:]
    trail_sign = ""
    for t in ("CR", "DB", "+", "-"):
        if p.endswith(t):
            trail_sign, p = t, p[: -len(t)]
            break
    dollar = p.startswith("$")
    if dollar:
        p = p[1:]

    int_pat, _, dec_pat = p.partition(".")
    n_int = sum(c in "9Z" for c in int_pat)
    n_dec = sum(c in "9Z" for c in dec_pat)
    v = pic_store(value, n_int, n_dec, signed=True)
    negative = v < 0
    a = abs(v)
    int_digits = str(int(a)).zfill(n_int)
    dec_digits = str(int((a - int(a)).scaleb(n_dec))).zfill(n_dec) if n_dec else ""

    # integer part with zero suppression
    out, di, suppressing = [], 0, True
    for c in int_pat:
        if c in "9Z":
            d = int_digits[di]
            di += 1
            if c == "Z" and suppressing and d == "0":
                out.append(" ")
            else:
                suppressing = False
                out.append(d)
        elif c == ",":
            out.append(" " if suppressing else ",")
        else:
            out.append(c)
    body = "".join(out)

    if "9" not in p and a == 0:  # all-Z picture with zero value -> all blanks
        return " " * len(_expand_pic(pic))
    if dec_pat:
        body += "." + dec_digits

    if dollar:
        body = "$" + body
    if lead_sign:
        body = ("-" if negative else ("+" if lead_sign == "+" else " ")) + body
    if trail_sign in ("+", "-"):
        body += "-" if negative else ("+" if trail_sign == "+" else " ")
    elif trail_sign:
        body += trail_sign if negative else "  "
    return body


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Working-storage fields for program SETTLE
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

WS_LINE = ""          # PIC X(13)
IN_AMOUNT = Decimal("0")   # PIC 9(7)V99
IN_NETWORK = ""        # PIC X
IN_COUNT = Decimal("0")    # PIC 9(3)
WS_RATE = Decimal("0")     # PIC V9(4)
WS_FEE_RAW = Decimal("0")  # PIC 9(6)V99
WS_FEE = Decimal("0")      # PIC 9(4)V99
WS_NET = Decimal("0")      # PIC 9(7)V99


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Main paragraph (COBOL MAIN-PARA)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def main(input_line: str) -> str:
    """Return everything COBOL program SETTLE would DISPLAY for one input line.

    Lines are joined by "\n" with NO trailing newline.
    """
    global WS_LINE, IN_AMOUNT, IN_NETWORK, IN_COUNT
    global WS_RATE, WS_FEE_RAW, WS_FEE, WS_NET

    # ACCEPT WS-LINE  (13-character fixed-width record)
    WS_LINE = input_line

    # MOVE WS-LINE(1:9) TO IN-AMOUNT   -> cols 1-9, PIC 9(7)V99 (implied decimal)
    # COBOL quirk: the input digits are interpreted as a whole number and then
    # the implied decimal point is applied by PIC storage.  The reviewer hint
    # says to keep only the last 7 digits of the 9-digit field.
    amt_text = WS_LINE[0:9]
    amt_digits = amt_text[-7:] if len(amt_text) >= 7 else amt_text.rjust(7, "0")[-7:]
    IN_AMOUNT = pic_store(Decimal(int(amt_digits)), 7, 2, signed=False)

    # MOVE WS-LINE(10:1) TO IN-NETWORK -> col 10, PIC X
    IN_NETWORK = WS_LINE[9:10]

    # MOVE WS-LINE(11:3) TO IN-COUNT   -> cols 11-13, PIC 9(3)
    IN_COUNT = pic_from_text(WS_LINE[10:13], 3, 0)

    # IF IN-AMOUNT = 0  DISPLAY "ERROR: EMPTY BATCH"  STOP RUN
    if IN_AMOUNT == 0:
        return "ERROR: EMPTY BATCH"

    # EVALUATE IN-NETWORK  MOVE rate TO WS-RATE (PIC V9(4), 4 implied decimals)
    if IN_NETWORK == "V":
        WS_RATE = Decimal("0.0195")
    elif IN_NETWORK == "M":
        WS_RATE = Decimal("0.0215")
    elif IN_NETWORK == "A":
        WS_RATE = Decimal("0.0350")
    else:
        WS_RATE = Decimal("0.0299")

    # COMPUTE WS-FEE-RAW = IN-AMOUNT * WS-RATE + IN-COUNT * 0.10
    #   full intermediate precision; truncate to 2 decimals on store into PIC 9(6)V99
    #   no ROUNDED, no ON SIZE ERROR -> high-order digits silently lost
    raw = IN_AMOUNT * WS_RATE + IN_COUNT * Decimal("0.10")
    WS_FEE_RAW = pic_store(raw, 6, 2, signed=False, rounded=False)

    # MOVE WS-FEE-RAW TO WS-FEE   (PIC 9(4)V99; high-order digits lost if > 9999.99)
    WS_FEE = pic_store(WS_FEE_RAW, 4, 2, signed=False, rounded=False)

    # IF WS-FEE > 500  MOVE 500 TO WS-FEE   (stored as 500.00)
    if WS_FEE > Decimal("500"):
        WS_FEE = pic_store(Decimal("500"), 4, 2, signed=False, rounded=False)

    # IF WS-FEE > IN-AMOUNT  MOVE IN-AMOUNT TO WS-FEE
    if WS_FEE > IN_AMOUNT:
        WS_FEE = pic_store(IN_AMOUNT, 4, 2, signed=False, rounded=False)

    # COMPUTE WS-NET = IN-AMOUNT - WS-FEE   (PIC 9(7)V99; unsigned -> sign lost)
    WS_NET = pic_store(IN_AMOUNT - WS_FEE, 7, 2, signed=False, rounded=False)

    # MOVE WS-FEE TO OUT-FEE   (PIC Z(3)9.99)
    out_fee = edit_picture(WS_FEE, "Z(3)9.99")

    # MOVE WS-NET TO OUT-NET   (PIC Z(6)9.99)
    out_net = edit_picture(WS_NET, "Z(6)9.99")

    # DISPLAY "FEE: " OUT-FEE
    # DISPLAY "NET: " OUT-NET
    line1 = "FEE: " + out_fee
    line2 = "NET: " + out_net

    return line1 + "\n" + line2


if __name__ == "__main__":
    import sys

    data = sys.stdin.readline()
    if data.endswith("\n"):
        data = data[:-1]
    print(main(data), end="")
